test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rahul bought a sweater and saved Rs. 200 when a discount of 25% was given. What was the price of the sweater before the discount?
solution:
**Given:**

Discount% = 25%

Rahul saved = Rs 200

**Formula used:**

Discount% = (discount/ M.P.) × 100

Where, M.P. = Marked price

**Calculation:**

Here, discount = Rs 200, discount% = 25 

⇒ Discount% = (Discount/ M.P.) × 100 

⇒ 25 = (200/M.P.) × 100 

⇒ M.P. = Rs 800

**Hence, price of the sweater before the discount was Rs800.**
